definition: Dated company-reported capture evidence for the core research queue and secondary candidates. Each record preserves reported facts, the project interpretation, and a counterpoint. These are not agent-specific revenue disclosures unless the company explicitly says so. Benchmarks are intentionally excluded from this earnings sequence.

facts: Cloud Infrastructure Services revenue: $99M, +39% year over year
Security revenue: $604M, +10% year over year
CIS contract commitments: more than $2.8B year to date, including a greater-than-$600M robotics contract
Non-GAAP operating margin: 25%, down five points year over year
records.captureRead: Early capture evidence. CIS growth and commitments support an AI-infrastructure hypothesis, but no agent-specific revenue, pricing, or attach rate is disclosed.
records.counterpoint: Delivery and other cloud-applications revenue declined, while future cloud and AI capacity is expected to increase capital and operating costs.

records.sourceLabel: Elastic Q1 FY2027 results and Form 10-Q
facts: Elastic Cloud revenue: $235M, +20% year over year, 49% of revenue
Sales-led subscription revenue: $399M, +18% year over year
Current RPO: $1.153B, +21% year over year
Total gross margin: 74%, down from 77% year over year
records.captureRead: Mechanism and consumption exposure are visible, but agent-specific usage, pricing, retention, and cash-flow proof are not disclosed.
records.counterpoint: Cloud-hosting costs rose faster than subscription revenue and pressured gross margin.

records.sourceLabel: Dynatrace Q1 FY2027 results and Form 10-Q
facts: Total ARR: $2.136B, +17% year over year
Total revenue: $555M, +16% year over year
Annualized logs consumption: $200M, growing more than 100% year over year
Subscription gross margin: 85%, down from 86% year over year
records.captureRead: Usage and product relevance are visible, but no agent-specific ARR, revenue, pricing, or retention cohort is disclosed.
records.counterpoint: Higher cloud-hosting costs and expected acquisition-related margin dilution remain material tests.

records.sourceLabel: F5 Q3 FY2026 results and Form 10-Q
facts: Total revenue: $865M, +11% year over year
Product revenue: +19% year over year
Systems revenue: $240M, +32% year over year
Software revenue: $223M, +7% year over year
records.captureRead: AI Gateway makes the company product-relevant, but adoption, attach, customer count, pricing, and revenue are not disclosed.
records.counterpoint: Growth was led by systems, and the gateway could remain a bundled feature rather than a paid control-plane product.

records.sourceLabel: Zscaler Q4 FY2026 results and FY2027 outlook
facts: Revenue: $898.2M, +25% year over year
ARR: $3.771B, +25% year over year; excluding Red Canary, $3.630B, +20%
Non-GAAP operating margin: 24%
Free cash flow: $60.8M, or 7% of revenue
records.captureRead: Security-for-agents is product-relevant and organic ARR grew, but the company has not disclosed paid agent-security adoption, pricing, revenue, or attach.
records.counterpoint: Red Canary contributed $141M of ARR, while capex and internal-use software reached $218.5M and reduced Q4 free-cash-flow margin.

facts: Revenue: $1.499B, +22% reported and +17% organic year over year
Dollar-based net expansion rate: 116%
Non-GAAP gross profit: $736M, or 49% margin
Free cash flow: $353M, or 24% of revenue
records.captureRead: Communications usage and customer expansion are strong, but agent-driven messages, revenue, pricing, retention, and incremental margin are not separately disclosed.
records.counterpoint: The carrier-heavy delivery layer makes the incremental gross-margin and mix outcome essential; broad growth is not proof of a paid agentic-communications mechanism.

facts: Revenue: $183.3M, +23% year over year
Security revenue: $41.7M, +43% year over year
RPO: $341M, +38% year over year; LTM net retention: 117%
Free cash flow: $3.6M; operating cash flow: $39.3M
records.captureRead: Machine-traffic relevance and relevant products are visible, but paid AI-delivery or agent-security adoption, revenue, and unit economics are not disclosed.
records.counterpoint: Free cash flow remains small and the ten largest customers represented 37% of revenue, so customer concentration and cash conversion remain material tests.

records.sourceLabel: Okta Q2 FY2027 results and outlook
facts: Revenue: $805M, +11% year over year; subscription revenue: $793M, +12%
RPO: $4.858B, +17% year over year; cRPO: $2.585B, +14%
Non-GAAP operating income: $226M, or 28% margin
Free cash flow: $227M, or 28% of revenue
records.captureRead: Agent identity is strategically relevant, but the company has not disclosed agent-identity revenue, pricing, customers, attach, or retention outcomes.
records.counterpoint: A professional-services partner change creates a reported-growth headwind and complicates simple demand comparisons; product announcements remain separate from paid adoption.
